preferred_family: sportsdataverse ESPN schedules/team_box/player_box; one upstream family
permission_requirements: Identify exact release/asset versions and intended local reconciliation purpose
Resolve host MIT versus producer data CC-BY-4.0 scope and underlying ESPN rights chain
Authoritative permission must cover the proposed access, copying and analysis; no public-URL inference
Record attribution, adaptation, storage, retention, redistribution and publication conditions separately
No substitute source, proxy, authorization workaround or rate-limit evasion

season.eligibility: Completed NBA team IDs 1-30, existing provider types 2/3; preserve and enumerate play-in/stage semantics

field_mapping_status: NBA Stats schema documented; ESPN exact column/unit contract not verified from inspected docs/shims

player_minutes.rounding_tolerance: At most one second per participating player for second-resolution source values; rounded whole-minute data cannot pass exact-duration validation without a separate declared rule
player_minutes.missing_ids_or_minutes: Enumerate and quarantine; never impute or use names to invent IDs

deduplication.identical_rows: One research canonical row plus all original locators; no raw deletion
deduplication.conflicts: Quarantine every conflicting identity/stat version; no newest-wins or averaging
deduplication.format_variants: Use one permitted format per dataset/version; CSV/Parquet/RDS are not separate games

provenance: actual later receipt time and raw SHA-256
explicit provider effective/publication time or null

acceptance.player_minute_denominator: All explicit participant rows in matched games; report DNP, unknown IDs, unknown minutes and duration checks separately
acceptance.score_consistency: Both team points equal reconciled final scores; no held NFL access
count_checks: points reconcile with documented scoring counts
rebound definitions reviewed before enforcing identities
acceptance.new_usable_game_count: Accepted canonical games absent from existing ESPN reference; never asset/file counts
acceptance.historical_pregame_proof: Not supplied by this pilot; no retrospective Class A claim

rollback: Original files, database rows, artifacts and production selectors remain untouched
Stage only into a new isolated research version after rights approval
On failure mark that version rejected/quarantined and leave it unselected
Retain permitted evidence and issue records under applicable retention terms; no destructive rollback
Verify original source/model/protocol hashes; stop on drift rather than modifying originals
